descriptions.en: Not an ArchiMate concept. Root for tool policy data stored in this package (allowed pairs, exchange notes).
descriptions.cs: Není ArchiMate koncept. Kořen tool-policy dat v tomto package (povolené vazby, exchange poznámky).

descriptions.en: Lite matrix row: relationship class + source class + target class. Enforced by tools, not by KC.
Open Exchange mapping notes for tools. Single instance iriLocal=exchange-spec.
A business-relevant state change that triggers or results from business behavior.
descriptions.cs: Obchodně významná změna stavu, která spouští business chování nebo z něj vzniká.

descriptions.en: Collective behavior of several business actors acting together as one architectural unit.
descriptions.cs: Společné působení více business aktérů jako jedna architektonická jednotka.

descriptions.en: Passive business information structure — the business meaning of information, not its application representation.
descriptions.cs: Pasivní business informační struktura — význam informace z pohledu businessu, ne její aplikační reprezentace.

descriptions.en: Lite convenience. Exchange tools expand to Assignment (component→system software→node, artifact→node).
Element type present in Open Exchange but not modeled as a first-class Lite class. Holds opaque Exchange payload for round-trip.
descriptions.cs: Typ prvku z Open Exchange, který není první třídou v Lite. Drží opaque payload pro round-trip.

descriptions.en: Relationship type from Open Exchange that is not a first-class Lite relationship class. Still requires relSource/relTarget.
descriptions.cs: Typ vztahu z Open Exchange mimo Lite slovník. Stále vyžaduje relSource/relTarget.

descriptions.en: Relationship source element (instance of ArchiMateElement or subclass).
descriptions.cs: Zdrojový prvek vztahu (instance ArchiMateElement nebo podtřídy).

descriptions.en: Relationship target element (instance of ArchiMateElement or subclass).
descriptions.cs: Cílový prvek vztahu (instance ArchiMateElement nebo podtřídy).

descriptions.en: Declares modeling granularity for an element, e.g. catalog, dr_minimum, application_detail, infrastructure_detail, or network_detail.
descriptions.cs: Určuje granularitu modelování prvku, např. catalog, dr_minimum, application_detail, infrastructure_detail nebo network_detail.

descriptions.en: Lifecycle status of the element in the estate, e.g. production, pilot, decommissioning, or retired.
descriptions.cs: Stav životního cyklu prvku v prostředí, např. production, pilot, decommissioning nebo retired.

descriptions.en: URI pointing to an authoritative external record such as a CMDB entry, ticket, or documentation.
descriptions.cs: URI odkazující na autoritativní externí záznam, např. položku CMDB, ticket nebo dokumentaci.

descriptions.en: Identifies which system is authoritative for this element's facts, e.g. ServiceNow CMDB or Terraform state.
descriptions.cs: Určuje, který systém je autoritativní pro fakta o tomto prvku, např. ServiceNow CMDB nebo Terraform state.

descriptions.en: Business or organizational owner accountable for the element, e.g. a business unit or department head.
descriptions.cs: Obchodní nebo organizační vlastník odpovědný za prvek, např. obchodní jednotka nebo vedoucí oddělení.

descriptions.en: Technical team or role responsible for running and changing the element, e.g. Platform team or DBAs.
descriptions.cs: Technický tým nebo role odpovědná za provoz a změny prvku, např. Platform team nebo DBA.

descriptions.en: Nature of a BusinessActor: person, organizational unit, or organization as a whole. Orthogonal to organizationScope.
descriptions.cs: Povaha BusinessActoru: osoba (person), organizační jednotka (organizationalUnit) nebo organizace jako celek (organization). Ortogonální k organizationScope.

descriptions.en: Whether a BusinessActor is internal or external relative to the modeled organization.
descriptions.cs: Určuje, zda je BusinessActor interní vůči modelované organizaci, nebo externí.

descriptions.en: Hierarchy level of a BusinessProcess (L0–L4). Orthogonal to modelingDepth.
descriptions.cs: Hierarchická úroveň BusinessProcess (L0–L4). Ortogonální k modelingDepth.

descriptions.en: Indicates who operates or owns the element: internal, external, or shared.
descriptions.cs: Určuje, kdo prvek provozuje nebo vlastní: internal (interní), external (externí) nebo shared (sdílený).

descriptions.en: Business criticality classification used for disaster recovery and prioritization, e.g. critical, high, medium, or low.
descriptions.cs: Klasifikace obchodní kritičnosti pro DR a prioritizaci, např. critical, high, medium nebo low.

descriptions.en: Recovery Time Objective — maximum acceptable downtime after an incident, e.g. 4h or 15m.
descriptions.cs: Recovery Time Objective — maximální přípustná doba výpadku po incidentu, např. 4h nebo 15m.

descriptions.en: Recovery Point Objective — maximum acceptable data loss window, e.g. 15m, 1h, or zero with sync replication.
descriptions.cs: Recovery Point Objective — maximální přípustné okno ztráty dat, např. 15m, 1h nebo zero při synchronní replikaci.

descriptions.en: Whether criticality was declared, inherited, or calculated.
descriptions.cs: Zda byla criticality stanovena přímo (declared), převzata (inherited), nebo vypočtena (calculated).

descriptions.en: Whether rto was declared, inherited, or calculated.
descriptions.cs: Zda bylo RTO stanoveno přímo (declared), převzato (inherited), nebo vypočteno (calculated).

descriptions.en: Whether rpo was declared, inherited, or calculated.
descriptions.cs: Zda bylo RPO stanoveno přímo (declared), převzato (inherited), nebo vypočteno (calculated).

descriptions.en: Qualifies the kind of dependency expressed by a relationship, e.g. runtime, data, identity, network, build-time, or organizational.
descriptions.cs: Upřesňuje typ závislosti vyjádřené vztahem, např. runtime, data, identity, network, build-time nebo organizational.

descriptions.en: States whether the dependency is mandatory or optional for degraded operation.
descriptions.cs: Určuje, zda je závislost pro omezený provoz povinná (mandatory) nebo volitelná (optional).

descriptions.en: Describes what limited operation remains if the dependency fails, e.g. read-only catalog or manual workaround.
descriptions.cs: Popisuje, jaký omezený provoz zůstane při selhání závislosti, např. read-only katalog nebo manuální workaround.

descriptions.en: Business consequence of failure of the dependency or element, e.g. cannot accept orders or login unavailable.
descriptions.cs: Obchodní dopad selhání závislosti nebo prvku, např. nelze přijímat objednávky nebo nedostupné přihlášení.

descriptions.en: Qualifies the business meaning of an Association, e.g. reportsTo, memberOf, locatedIn, or other.
descriptions.cs: Upřesňuje obchodní význam Association, např. reportsTo, memberOf, locatedIn nebo other.

descriptions.en: Optional free-text note on a relationship; required when associationKind is other.
descriptions.cs: Volitelná textová poznámka k vztahu; povinná, pokud je associationKind other.

descriptions.en: Communication protocol used at an interface or flow, e.g. HTTPS, TCP, gRPC, or Kafka.
descriptions.cs: Komunikační protokol na rozhraní nebo toku, např. HTTPS, TCP, gRPC nebo Kafka.

descriptions.en: Architecturally significant TCP or UDP port number, e.g. 443, 5432, or 9092.
descriptions.cs: Architektonicky významné číslo TCP/UDP portu, např. 443, 5432 nebo 9092.

descriptions.en: Whether an interaction is synchronous (blocking request/response) or asynchronous, e.g. true for REST or false for queue publish.
descriptions.cs: Určuje, zda je interakce synchronní (blokující request/response) nebo asynchronní, např. true pro REST nebo false pro publikaci do fronty.

descriptions.en: Authentication mechanism expected at an interface or flow, e.g. OIDC, mTLS, API key, or Kerberos.
descriptions.cs: Očekávaný autentizační mechanismus na rozhraní nebo toku, např. OIDC, mTLS, API key nebo Kerberos.

descriptions.en: Timeout policy relevant to resilience analysis, e.g. 5s, 30s, or 2m.
descriptions.cs: Politika timeoutu relevantní pro analýzu odolnosti, např. 5s, 30s nebo 2m.

descriptions.en: Retry and backoff expectations for a dependency, e.g. 3 retries with exponential backoff or at-least-once with DLQ.
descriptions.cs: Očekávání opakování a backoffu u závislosti, např. 3 opakování s exponenciálním backoffem nebo at-least-once s DLQ.

descriptions.en: Technical name of the message, event, or payload exchanged, e.g. OrderCreated or CustomerDTO.
descriptions.cs: Technický název zprávy, události nebo payloadu, např. OrderCreated nebo CustomerDTO.

descriptions.en: Business description of what is transferred by a Flow, e.g. customer orders or identity assertions.
descriptions.cs: Obchodní popis toho, co Flow přenáší, např. zákaznické objednávky nebo identity assertions.

descriptions.en: Kind of Flow transferred: data payload, event/message, control signal, or physical transfer.
descriptions.cs: Druh Flow: datová zátěž (data), událost/zpráva (event), řídicí signál (control) nebo fyzický přenos (physical).

descriptions.en: How a behavioral element accesses a BusinessObject or DataObject: read, write, or readWrite.
descriptions.cs: Způsob přístupu behaviorálního prvku k BusinessObject nebo DataObject: read, write nebo readWrite.

descriptions.en: Business or technical classification of a DataObject, e.g. master, transactional, audit, reference, or cache.
descriptions.cs: Obchodní nebo technická klasifikace DataObject, např. master, transactional, audit, reference nebo cache.

descriptions.en: System of record that masters this data object, e.g. CRM, ERP, or IdP.
descriptions.cs: Autoritativní systém (system of record) pro tento datový objekt, např. CRM, ERP nebo IdP.

descriptions.en: Retention period or policy for the data, e.g. 7 years, 90 days, or GDPR erasure on request.
descriptions.cs: Doba nebo politika uchovávání dat, např. 7 let, 90 dní nebo výmaz dle GDPR na žádost.

descriptions.en: Whether the data can be rebuilt from upstream sources after loss, e.g. true for a derived search index.
descriptions.cs: Určuje, zda lze data po ztrátě znovu sestavit z upstream zdrojů, např. true u odvozeného search indexu.

descriptions.en: Whether backups are required for this data object, e.g. true for customer master or false for ephemeral cache.
descriptions.cs: Určuje, zda jsou pro tento datový objekt vyžadovány zálohy, např. true u customer master nebo false u dočasné cache.

descriptions.en: Information security classification of the data, e.g. public, internal, confidential, or restricted/PII.
descriptions.cs: Bezpečnostní klasifikace informací, např. public, internal, confidential nebo restricted/PII.

descriptions.en: Runtime environment name for deployed elements, e.g. prod, staging, test, or dr.
descriptions.cs: Název běhového prostředí nasazených prvků, např. prod, staging, test nebo dr.

descriptions.en: Cluster or platform grouping where the element runs, e.g. k8s-prod-a or esx-cluster-01.
descriptions.cs: Skupina clusteru nebo platformy, kde prvek běží, např. k8s-prod-a nebo esx-cluster-01.

descriptions.en: Logical namespace within a platform, e.g. a Kubernetes namespace like crm-prod.
descriptions.cs: Logický namespace v rámci platformy, např. Kubernetes namespace crm-prod.

descriptions.en: Runtime technology hosting the component, e.g. JVM 21, Node 20, or .NET 8.
descriptions.cs: Běhové prostředí hostující komponentu, např. JVM 21, Node 20 nebo .NET 8.

descriptions.en: Configured replica or instance count for capacity and high-availability reasoning, e.g. 3 or 2 for active-passive.
descriptions.cs: Nakonfigurovaný počet replik nebo instancí pro kapacitu a HA, např. 3 nebo 2 pro active-passive.

descriptions.en: High-availability pattern in use, e.g. active-active, active-passive, or none.
descriptions.cs: Vzor vysoké dostupnosti, např. active-active, active-passive nebo none.

descriptions.en: Primary operating site for the element, e.g. DC1, eu-central-1a, or Prague.
descriptions.cs: Primární provozní lokalita prvku, např. DC1, eu-central-1a nebo Praha.

descriptions.en: Disaster-recovery site for the element, e.g. DC2, eu-central-1b, or Brno.
descriptions.cs: Lokalita disaster recovery pro prvek, např. DC2, eu-central-1b nebo Brno.

descriptions.en: Where deployment artifacts or configuration come from, e.g. GitOps repo, CI pipeline, or Helm chart registry.
descriptions.cs: Odkud pocházejí deployment artefakty nebo konfigurace, např. GitOps repo, CI pipeline nebo Helm chart registry.

descriptions.en: VLAN identifier for a CommunicationNetwork, e.g. 120 or 900.
descriptions.cs: Identifikátor VLAN pro CommunicationNetwork, např. 120 nebo 900.

descriptions.en: CIDR block of a CommunicationNetwork, e.g. 10.12.0.0/16 or 192.168.10.0/24.
descriptions.cs: CIDR blok CommunicationNetwork, např. 10.12.0.0/16 nebo 192.168.10.0/24.

descriptions.en: Security or network zone label used for trust-boundary reasoning, e.g. APP_NET, DB_NET, or DMZ.
descriptions.cs: Označení bezpečnostní nebo síťové zóny pro analýzu trust boundary, např. APP_NET, DB_NET nebo DMZ.

descriptions.en: Site affiliation for network or deployment concepts, e.g. DC1, DC2, or branch-42.
descriptions.cs: Přiřazení k lokalitě u síťových nebo deployment konceptů, např. DC1, DC2 nebo branch-42.

descriptions.en: Routing domain or VRF name for a network, e.g. corp-prod, pci, or guest.
descriptions.cs: Routing doména nebo název VRF pro síť, např. corp-prod, pci nebo guest.

descriptions.en: Type of CommunicationNetwork segment, e.g. vlan, subnet, wan, dmz, overlay, management, storage, or other.
descriptions.cs: Typ segmentu CommunicationNetwork, např. vlan, subnet, wan, dmz, overlay, management, storage nebo other.

descriptions.en: Operational role of a CommunicationNetwork in the estate, e.g. production, management, backup, dmz, or wan.
descriptions.cs: Provozní role CommunicationNetwork v prostředí, např. production, management, backup, dmz nebo wan.

descriptions.en: Fully qualified domain name of a significant technology interface, e.g. api.crm.example.com.
descriptions.cs: Plně kvalifikované doménové jméno významného technologického rozhraní, např. api.crm.example.com.

descriptions.en: Virtual IP of a load-balanced or floating endpoint, e.g. 10.12.1.10.
descriptions.cs: Virtuální IP load-balancovaného nebo plovoucího endpointu, např. 10.12.1.10.

descriptions.en: Significant stable IP address of an interface, not every ephemeral node IP.
descriptions.cs: Významná stabilní IP adresa rozhraní, ne každá efemérní IP uzlu.

descriptions.en: Reference to TLS certificate material for an interface, e.g. a vault path or ACM ARN.
descriptions.cs: Odkaz na TLS certifikát pro rozhraní, např. cesta ve vaultu nebo ACM ARN.

descriptions.en: Source security or network zone on a Flow, e.g. APP_NET or DMZ.
descriptions.cs: Zdrojová bezpečnostní nebo síťová zóna na Flow, např. APP_NET nebo DMZ.

descriptions.en: Target security or network zone on a Flow, e.g. DB_NET or INTERNET.
descriptions.cs: Cílová bezpečnostní nebo síťová zóna na Flow, např. DB_NET nebo INTERNET.

descriptions.en: Direction of a Flow relative to a trust boundary, e.g. outbound, inbound, or bidirectional.
descriptions.cs: Směr Flow vůči trust boundary, např. outbound, inbound nebo bidirectional.

descriptions.en: Reference to the firewall or security policy governing a Flow, e.g. FW-RULE-4421.
descriptions.cs: Odkaz na firewall nebo bezpečnostní politiku řídící Flow, např. FW-RULE-4421.

descriptions.cs: Pohled DiagramView určující, které téma diagram zobrazuje, např. catalog, dependencies, application, technology nebo network.

descriptions.en: Kind of visual node in a diagram: element, container, or label.

descriptions.cs: Souřadnice X ohraničujícího boxu ViewNode v layoutu diagramu.

descriptions.cs: Souřadnice Y ohraničujícího boxu ViewNode v layoutu diagramu.

descriptions.en: Height of the ViewNode bounding box in the diagram layout.
descriptions.cs: Výška ohraničujícího boxu ViewNode v layoutu diagramu.

descriptions.cs: JSON kódovaný vizuální styl pro view koncept, používaný nástroji pro vykreslování diagramů.

descriptions.cs: Zdrojový ViewNode ViewConnection — diagramový uzel, kde hrana začíná.

descriptions.cs: Cílový ViewNode ViewConnection — diagramový uzel, kde hrana končí.

descriptions.en: JSON-encoded bend points defining the path of a ViewConnection edge.
descriptions.cs: JSON kódované ohybové body definující trasu hrany ViewConnection.

descriptions.en: Annotation on a class entity stating its ArchiMate layer, e.g. business, application, technology, physical, composite, motivation, or implementation.
descriptions.cs: Anotace na entitě třídy udávající ArchiMate vrstvu, např. business, application, technology, physical, composite, motivation nebo implementation.

descriptions.en: Annotation on a class entity for an ArchiMate overlay, e.g. risk-and-security.
descriptions.cs: Anotace na entitě třídy pro ArchiMate overlay, např. risk-and-security.

descriptions.cs: Anotace na třídě vztahu s Open Exchange xsi:type; chybí-li, jde o nestandardní typ (např. DeployedOn).

descriptions.cs: U instance AllowedRelationship: třída vztahu povolená v matici.

descriptions.cs: U instance AllowedRelationship: povolená třída zdrojového prvku.

descriptions.cs: U instance AllowedRelationship: povolená třída cílového prvku.

descriptions.en: Version string of the ArchiMate Lite catalog carried on ExchangeSpec, e.g. 2.3.1.
descriptions.cs: Řetězec verze katalogu ArchiMate Lite na ExchangeSpec, např. 2.3.1.

descriptions.en: Human-readable note describing the Open Exchange file format supported by tools.
descriptions.cs: Lidsky čitelná poznámka popisující podporovaný formát Open Exchange souboru.

descriptions.en: Rule for mapping element classes to Open Exchange xsi:type values.
descriptions.cs: Pravidlo mapování tříd prvků na hodnoty Open Exchange xsi:type.

descriptions.en: Rule for mapping relationship classes to Open Exchange xsi:type when exchangeType is set.
descriptions.cs: Pravidlo mapování tříd vztahů na Open Exchange xsi:type, pokud je nastaven exchangeType.

descriptions.en: Rule for how DeployedOn relationships should be expanded on Open Exchange export.
descriptions.cs: Pravidlo, jak expandovat vztahy DeployedOn při exportu do Open Exchange.

descriptions.en: Rule for how Risk elements should be represented in Open Exchange.
descriptions.cs: Pravidlo reprezentace prvků Risk v Open Exchange.

descriptions.en: Rule for how view concepts map to Open Exchange view structures.
descriptions.cs: Pravidlo mapování view konceptů na struktury pohledů v Open Exchange.

descriptions.en: Rule for how instance identifiers are chosen when exporting to Open Exchange.
descriptions.cs: Pravidlo výběru identifikátorů instancí při exportu do Open Exchange.

descriptions.en: Links a ViewNode or ViewConnection to its owning DiagramView.
descriptions.cs: Propojuje ViewNode nebo ViewConnection s vlastnícím DiagramView.

descriptions.en: Original Open Exchange xsi:type string preserved for foreign or atypical instances.
descriptions.cs: Původní Open Exchange xsi:type zachovaný pro cizí nebo atypické instance.

descriptions.cs: JSON bag Open Exchange properties/atributů nemapovaných na Lite properties.

descriptions.en: Opaque fragment for Open Exchange constructs not represented as Lite statements.
descriptions.cs: Opaque fragment pro Open Exchange konstrukty bez Lite statementů.

descriptions.en: Marks instances owned by Open Exchange import for re-import orphan review.
descriptions.cs: Označuje instance z Open Exchange importu pro orphan review při reimportu.

value.string: archimate-lite
Root for Lite tool-policy data in this package (allowed pairs, exchange notes). Not used in architecture diagrams.
AllowedRelationship rows; the single ExchangeSpec entity.
Declares one allowed (relationship type, source class, target class) triple for tool-side matrix checks. KC does not enforce it.
Assignment BusinessActor→BusinessRole; Serving TechnologyService→ApplicationComponent; DeployedOn ApplicationComponent→SystemSoftware.
Holds Open Exchange mapping notes for importers/exporters. Prefer a single instance with iriLocal=exchange-spec.
exchange-spec with catalogVersion, exchangeFormat, and DeployedOn/Risk/views rules.
Abstract root of all ArchiMate Lite concepts (elements, relationships, views). Do not instantiate directly.
Prefer a concrete subclass such as ApplicationComponent or Serving.
Abstract parent of structural/behavioral architecture elements. Instances are typed via instanceOf to a concrete subclass.
BusinessService, ApplicationComponent, Node, Risk — never ArchiMateElement itself.
Abstract parent of relationship entities. Each relationship is its own entity with relSource and relTarget.
Serving, Access, Flow, DeployedOn — create a relationship entity, not a free-form link.
Abstract parent of diagram/view constructs used to present the model.
DiagramView, ViewNode, ViewConnection.
business

An organizational entity capable of performing behavior — a person, organizational unit, or organization. Classify nature with actorKind and relation to the modeled org with organizationScope (not ownership).
Organizational unit owning CRM (organizationalUnit+internal); named person Petr Novák (person+internal); external payment provider (organization+external).
business
A responsibility that an actor may assume. Use for ownership and operating roles, not for technical accounts.
Business owner; system owner; on-call operator; compliance officer.
business
An externally visible unit of business behavior offered to customers or the organization.
Customer onboarding; invoice issuance; employee self-service; payment acceptance.
business
A sequence of business behaviors achieving a specific outcome. Use for key processes the system supports.
Order-to-cash; claim handling; identity provisioning request; month-end close.
business
Stable area of responsibility or work. Answers 'what is this unit accountable for?' — unlike BusinessProcess, which answers 'what happens when…'. Use as the primary business-layer decomposition.
Data Protection; Compliance Management; Customer Onboarding as a standing function (not a process run).
business

Use for events that start a business process, result from a process, or mark a significant business state change. Prefer Triggering to/from BusinessProcess. Not only a migration helper — a lasting part of the target model.
Přijetí dat měření; Přijetí nominace; Uzavření trhu; Vznik požadavku; Přijetí regulačního rozhodnutí.
business

Use only when the object truly represents joint action of multiple actors. Do not use for a single external organization, vendor, or partner — those are BusinessActor with actorKind=organization and organizationScope=external. Compose of BusinessActors; assign to processes/functions; optionally realize a BusinessService.
Cross-org market settlement collaboration; joint incident response cell spanning two units — not Microsoft, T-Mobile, or a bank as a whole.
business

BusinessObject = business meaning of information. DataObject = application/technical representation. Access from BusinessProcess, BusinessFunction, or BusinessService. Do not model SAP tables or APIs as BusinessObject.
Měřená data; Nominace; Výsledky trhu; Smlouva; Faktura; Platební příkaz; Požadavek zákazníka.
application
A modular, deployable application building block. At L0 model the whole system; at L2 split into frontend, backend, workers, etc.
CRM as a whole; web frontend; API backend; batch worker; shared microservice.
application
Application behavior exposed to the environment (users or other systems).
CreateCustomer service; SearchOrders; Authentication API capability; Reporting service.
application
A point of access where application services are made available to users or other applications.
REST /v1/customers; customer web UI; Kafka topic OrdersIn; SOAP gateway.
application
Automated behavior internal to an application component. Prefer when modeling internal capability, not a full workflow.
ValidateOrder; CalculateTax; HashPassword; IndexDocument.
application
An application-level workflow or batch sequence spanning one or more functions.
Nightly settlement batch; document OCR pipeline; password-reset flow.
application
An application-level state change of interest for integration or operations.
OrderCreated; PaymentFailed; UserLockedOut; CertificateExpiring.
application
A temporary or logical aggregation of application components cooperating as one unit.
Checkout collaboration (cart + payment + inventory); login collaboration (UI + IdP adapter).
application
A passive structure of data meaningful to the architecture (not every table or cache entry).
Customer master; order transactions; audit log; configuration store; search index.
technology
A technology capability used by applications — databases, identity, DNS, storage, messaging, load balancing.
PostgreSQL database service; Keycloak/IdP; corporate DNS; object storage; Kafka cluster service.
technology
An access point to a technology service that is architecturally significant (stable endpoints, VIPs).
DB listener host:5432; ingress VIP; Kubernetes API endpoint; DNS resolver address.
technology
A computational resource on which artifacts and system software are deployed (logical or virtual).
Application VM; Kubernetes worker node; bastion host; managed DB instance endpoint node.
technology
A physical ICT resource. Use when the physical appliance matters for DR, network, or ownership.
Physical server; firewall appliance; hardware load balancer; storage array controller.
technology
Software environment that hosts or runs application artifacts (OS, platform, middleware, DB engine).
RHEL; Kubernetes; PostgreSQL engine; JVM runtime; message broker runtime.
technology
A physical piece of data used or produced in deployment — images, packages, charts, config bundles.
Container image; Helm chart; Terraform module; signed config package; WAR/JAR release.
technology
A communication medium or logical network segment relevant to security/DR (VLAN, subnet, WAN, DMZ). Set networkKind from infrastructure/network depth (L3+); add cidr, vlanId, and networkRole at L4.
APP_NET VLAN 10.1.0.0/16 production; DC-WAN; DMZ; backup network.
technology

A named communication path between nodes or networks for impact analysis. Use Path when the route itself matters (WAN, replication link, zoned crossing) rather than Flow (what is transferred) or Association (membership or attachment).
DC1↔DC2 replication path; primary site to DR site WAN path; app-tier to DB-tier path spanning VLANs.
physical
A physical structure or environment such as a datacenter or technical building.
DC1 Prague; colo facility; head-office server room.
composite
A geographic or organizational place. Use when site matters for DR, latency, or regulation.
Prague; Brno DR site; EU-central region; branch office.
motivation
A statement of need that must be realized by the architecture (availability, RTO/RPO, compliance).
RTO ≤ 4h; RPO ≤ 15m; 99.9% availability; GDPR retention constraint.
motivation
Result of an analysis used to motivate decisions (criticality, maturity, health).
Business criticality = high; architecture fitness review; dependency risk score.
motivation
risk-and-security
A risk relevant to the architecture (Risk and Security overlay). Prefer for known SPOFs and threat outcomes.
Single WAN link between DCs; sole IdP without standby; unencrypted backup channel.
implementation
Difference between baseline and target architecture that a change initiative must close.
Missing HA for payment DB; no DR runbook for IdP; absent network segmentation.
implementation
A series of actions designed to achieve a goal within a defined timeframe.
CRM migration wave 1; network zoning project; HA database rollout.
Composition
Whole–part where the part has the same lifetime as the whole (strong ownership).
CRM system composed of Frontend+Backend+Worker; Node composed of Devices.
Aggregation
Whole–part grouping without shared lifetime (loose collection).
ApplicationCollaboration aggregating components; cluster aggregating nodes.
Assignment
Allocation of responsibility or deployment: actor→role, role→service, software→node, artifact→node.
BusinessActor→BusinessRole; SystemSoftware→Node; Artifact→Node.
Realization
More concrete element realizes a more abstract one (component realizes service/requirement).
ApplicationComponent→BusinessService; ApplicationComponent→ApplicationService; Device→TechnologyService.
Serving
Provider serves a consumer with behavior or capability. Preferred over Used-By for Lite models.
ApplicationService→BusinessProcess; TechnologyService→ApplicationComponent; Device→CommunicationNetwork.
Access
Behavioral element accesses a passive information structure. Prefer BusinessObject on the business layer and DataObject on the application layer. Set accessMode to read, write, or readWrite.
BusinessProcess→Měřená data (BusinessObject, readWrite); Backend→CustomerData (DataObject, readWrite); Reporting→Orders (read).
Flow

Transfer of information, value, or goods between elements — not a 'uses' or Serving relationship. Always set flowLabel (what flows). Use messageOrObject for the technical payload name; attach protocol/port/zone at L2–L4.
Backend→Payment Gateway (flowLabel=Customer orders, flowKind=data, protocol=HTTPS); WAN→APP_NET (Inter-DC replication).
Triggering
Temporal or causal triggering: source triggers target behavior.
BusinessEvent→BusinessProcess; ApplicationEvent→ApplicationProcess; Process A triggers Process B; schedule triggers batch.
Specialization
Generalization/specialization between elements of the same kind.
Generic ApplicationComponent specialized as PaymentGatewayComponent.
Association
Undirected structural link when no more specific relationship fits. Prefer specific types when possible.
Requirement↔ApplicationComponent; Node↔Facility; Facility↔Location; Node↔CommunicationNetwork.
Influence
Motivation influence: how an assessment or risk affects a requirement or service.
Assessment→Requirement; Risk→BusinessService.
Lite convenience for deployment. Exchange tools expand to Assignment (e.g. component→system software→node, artifact→node).
ApplicationComponent→SystemSoftware; Artifact→Node.

Expresses process hierarchy depth, not technology modeling depth. L0 = top business domain; L1 = main process; L2 = process; L3 = subprocess/detail; L4 = finer detail if needed.
